name: parallel-decomp-gate-verdict
title: Parallel-decomposition gate verdict: evaluateDecompositionGate (program Story 2)
description: Implement the pure decomposition-gate verdict function evaluateDecompositionGate in a NEW file core/parallel-decomposition-gate.ts, consuming the Story-1 overlap engine (computeWriteSet/globsOverlap/classifyBroadness from core/parallel-decomposition-overlap.ts). It computes advisories[] plus an optional hard block reason from scope facts only (it does NOT consult cfg.mode for enforcement; the caller canStartDevGuard does that in Story 5). Per spec docs/parallel-decomposition-spec.md sections 4.3/4.4. Kept in a separate file from the frozen contract (parallel-decomposition.ts) so it stays disjoint from Stories 3/4 and is reconciled by Story 5.
